priddy.translation: [人名] 普里迪; [地名] [英国、英国] 普里迪

pride.definition:
n. a feeling of self-respect and personal worth
n. satisfaction with your (or another's) achievements
n. the trait of being spurred on by a dislike of falling below your standards
n. a group of lions
pride.translation:
n. 骄傲, 自尊心, 自豪, 精华, 勇气
vt. 以...自豪

prided.translation: v. 以…而自豪, 得意于…( pride的过去式和过去分词 ); 自豪, 骄傲, 得意

prideful.definition:
s having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy
s joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success

pridefulness.definition: n. a feeling of self-respect and personal worth
pridefulness.translation: n. 自豪；骄傲；自尊心 (pride的变形)

prides.definition:
n a feeling of self-respect and personal worth
n satisfaction with your (or another's) achievements
n the trait of being spurred on by a dislike of falling below your standards
n a group of lions
n unreasonable and inordinate self-esteem (personified as one of the deadly sins)
v be proud of
prides.translation:
n. 自尊( pride的名词复数 ); 骄傲; 自满; （马的）精力
v. 以…而自豪, 得意于…( pride的第三人称单数 ); 自豪, 骄傲, 得意

pridham.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 普里德姆绰号，明智的人，来源于古法语，含义是“好+人”(good+man)

pridian.definition: a. Of or pertaining to the day before, or yesterday.
pridian.translation: a. 前一天的, 昨天的, 以前的,从前的

priding.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Pride
priding.translation: v. 以…而自豪, 得意于…( pride的现在分词 ); 自豪, 骄傲, 得意

pridinol.translation: [化] 普立地诺; 哌二苯丙醇
